examples: Keep the whole screen for your terminals and still jump to any agent, layout or terminal in two clicks.
Reach settings, themes or skills from the home tab without opening the drawer.
how_to: On a desktop, close the agents drawer with the panel button beside the logo: it shrinks to a column of icons on the left.
The claw at the top opens the full drawer again; the two tabs under it switch between the menu and your agents.
On the agents tab each icon is one drawer section (pinned, layouts, groups, projects, terminals, browsers): click it for a list of that section's rows with their lights, and click a row to open it.
